entities.name: Fall of Terisia City
entities.description: An event in the Brothers' War that left the oldest and most advanced city-state on Terisiare in ruins.

entities.name: Terisia City
entities.description: The oldest and most advanced city-state on Terisiare, known for its Ivory Towers.

entities.name: Ivory Tower
entities.description: The order of bookkeepers of Terisia City.

entities.name: The Third Path
entities.description: A secret organization seated in Terisia City, led by the Archimandrite.

entities.name: Archimandrite
entities.description: Leader of the Third Path; some said the sandstorm was their work.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Leader of the Fallaji who besieged Terisia City.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Mishra's brother, with whom he reached a stalemate in the east.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: A priestly brotherhood of humans, secretly worshippers of the Phyrexians, that betrayed the city.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Beings secretly worshipped by the Gixians.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: A defender who cast Hurkyl's Recall and was killed.

entities.name: Drafna
entities.description: A defender who tried to retaliate and ordered the remaining artifacts collected.

entities.name: Hajar
entities.description: Mishra's loyal bodyguard who commanded the sacking force.

entities.name: Feldon
entities.description: Defender who gave the Sylex to Loran.

entities.name: Loran
entities.description: Fled with the Sylex but was later captured by Ashnod.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Captured Loran and took the Sylex, keeping it from Mishra.

entities.name: Sylex
entities.description: A dangerous artifact entrusted to Loran.

entities.name: Kovrian Wastelands
entities.description: Where the ruins of Terisia City are believed to lie today.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war in which Terisia City fell.

events.summary: Mishra, denied support by the city council, sends his armies to besiege Terisia City.
events.quote: His armies were then sent to besiege Terisia City for their refusal.

events.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix betrays the city and opens the gates to the Fallaji.
events.quote: finally betrayed the city after several months of siege, and opened the gates to the onslaught

events.summary: Hurkyl dies as a defender after casting the spell later named Hurkyl's Recall.
events.quote: Hurkyl died as one of the defenders

events.summary: Terisia City is sacked under Hajar; the Ivory Towers are razed and the city burned.
events.quote: The beautiful Ivory Towers were all razed to the ground, and the rest of the city burned to cinders.

events.summary: Feldon gives the Sylex to Loran to flee with.
events.quote: so he gave it to Loran and asked her to flee with him on her quick legs

events.summary: Loran is later captured by Ashnod, who takes the Sylex but keeps it from Mishra.
events.quote: she was later captured by Ashnod

relations.note: Secretly worshippers, in league with Mishra.
The Third Path is led by the Archimandrite.

relations.quote: he reached a stalemate with Urza in the east
